test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Because of the loss of ______ and lack of food, animals are forced to enter villages.
solution:
The correct answer is** "habitats"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given fill-in-the-blank, the most appropriate option is **'habitats.'**
 
• **Habitats**: the natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organisms.
 
 
• **Example**: *wild chimps in their natural **habitat.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **option 3.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__Let's look at the meaning and examples of the other options.

 
 

 **Words**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**
 
 

 **Ecosystem** 
 a biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment.
 The marine **ecosystem** of the northern Gulf had suffered irreparable damage.
 
 

 **culture**
 the way of life, especially the general customs and beliefs, of a particular group of people at a particular time.
 This is one of the most ancient **cultures** in the world.
 
 

 **grasslands**
 large areas of land covered with grass
 Conservation groups are restoring **grasslands** in the Midwest.
